current_bottleneck: The capped one-shot family has support validity but weak native state dependence. Prior recurrent local-scale/asinh variants failed because recurrence was paired with clipping, rollout-loss tuning, and optional slow-latent adapters; the clean missing test is recurrence plus support-valid logit transitions without extra structural paths.
last_result_summary: Paradigm shifted from one-shot full-path transition flow to an autoregressive factorization of the conditional joint law: p(future | history) = product_t p(logit(IV_t)-logit(IV_{t-1}) | generated history/state). This preserves the vanilla generative core, keeps support validity by sigmoid inversion, and makes state dependence native rather than inferred from a noised future block.
next_step_recommendation: Implement and train 303a-v0 as a recurrent support-valid logit-transition flow. Use a GRU history/state encoder, a vanilla conditional flow over the next 25D logit transition, teacher-forced one-step likelihood/energy training across 30 steps, and recursive sampling that updates history with generated states. Avoid slow latent adapters, low-rank readouts, bounded idio/EC paths, retrieval, or evaluator-specific losses.
